home.whatIsAnsariDesc1: NIRN — New Islamic Republic of Nepal is a vision for a self-sustaining and harmonious community built on faith, education, agriculture, livestock, technology, nature, and unity.
home.whatIsAnsariDesc2: We provide quality housing opportunities for families, individuals, and newcomers, with homes available for both purchase and rent. Our aim is to create a safe, welcoming, and well-planned community where people can live, work, learn, and build a secure future together.
home.whatIsAnsariDesc3: With a strong focus on community security, peaceful living, and a connection with nature, NIRN is designed to provide a comfortable environment for both present and future generations. Faith • Knowledge • Agriculture • Technology • Nature • Community • Homes • Security
home.howAtsDesc: Applicant Tracking Systems filter resumes before recruiters see them. We optimize your CV to pass ATS parsing and reach human reviewers.
home.recommendSectionSubtitle: Coaches and hiring experts recommend clear, structured CVs—ANSARI helps candidates deliver exactly that.
home.testimonial1Quote: I point candidates to ANSARI when they need honest feedback before they apply. The grading highlights real gaps, and the layouts stay easy for both ATS and recruiters to scan.
home.testimonial2Quote: We look for clarity and relevance in the first screen. Tools that help applicants tighten structure and keywords—like ANSARI—align with how modern hiring actually works.
home.testimonial3Quote: Students often send dense walls of text. ANSARI keeps CVs scannable and job-specific—exactly what reviewers want in those first thirty seconds.
